locations.name: Absinthe Arcade

exterior.description: A dignified four-storey Prague-inspired limestone and plaster building carrying a monumental Green Fairy mural, the Headphone Gentleman keystone, green and purple retrofit conduit, a black pixel-neon marquee, stained-glass doors, a street cabinet and wet-cobble props.
exterior.entry_condition: Always accessible through the main stained-glass entrance from the Clocktower Plaza side street.

interior.theme: A grand historic amusement hall made commercially ridiculous by an absinthe-and-arcade retrofit

functions: Token exchange and twisted arcade mini-games
Beer Pong Saint Relic acquisition through the rigged claw machine
Backpack Girl couchsurf and Ballad of the Bros quest origin
Club flyer placement and fake VIP wristband callback
Arcade-side discovery and transition to The Absinthium Taproom
Three-token permanent unlock and transition to the Claw Machine Maintenance Closet Restroom
locations.image_generation_master_brief: A grand historic Prague-inspired amusement hall seen in fixed HD-2D perspective. Cream stone arches, carved plaster, iron mezzanine rails, stained glass, warm amber pendant lamps and a glossy black-and-white checkerboard floor remain sincere and beautiful. A catastrophically tacky green-and-purple arcade retrofit cuts through them: sticker-bombed cabinets, exposed conduit, pixel signs, localized spectral mist, and bad tourist microcopy. A monumental cracked absinthe-bottle bar is the navigational anchor. The main floor loops clearly around it; an L-shaped north wing becomes denser and darker without losing readable paths.

nodes.visual_description: Wet cobblestones lead toward the four-storey historic facade. The Green Fairy mural, Headphone Gentleman, black neon marquee, stained-glass doors, exterior cabinet, awning, chalkboard and window cat establish the location before entry.
nodes.camera_note: Frame enough upper facade to read the mural and marquee while keeping the door and sidewalk interactions reachable.

nodes.visual_description: Open green-and-purple stained-glass doors cross a shallow stone threshold into glossy diagonal checkerboard tile. Warm pendant lamps establish depth; cabinet rows and the bottle bar are visible beyond.

nodes.display_name: Token Exchange and Backpack Girl Floor Spot
nodes.visual_description: A brass-and-black token machine sits between two cabinet ends under a hand-painted TOKENS HERE arrow. Backpack Girl occupies a warm floor pool beside it with her enormous pack, ukulele, notebook and half a kebab. Her area looks inhabited rather than pitiable.

A circular bar wraps the base of a monumental green glass absinthe bottle/reservoir rising toward the decorated ceiling. One controlled crack glows within the glass without making the structure unsafe. Brass rails, bottle shelves and amber task lights keep it plausible; green liquid light and bad branded coasters make it ridiculous.

Readable cabinet aisles orbit the bar with generous circulation. Hero cabinets for Frogger: Existential Edition, Street Fighter: Identity Crisis and Kebab Kombat are separated by generic machines, standing tables and localized mist so their silhouettes remain distinct.
nodes.occlusion_note: Cabinet tops may overlap character heads slightly in the fixed camera; control decks and floor edges must remain unobscured.

nodes.visual_description: A gold-trimmed claw machine occupies a shallow arch beneath a painfully sincere PRIZES sign. The Beer Pong Saint Relic hangs among worthless plush prizes, visibly reachable but mechanically rigged. A scratched service note and prize chute provide strategy clues.

Narrow mirror panels alternate with carved stone pilasters. Reflections are represented by desynchronized character afterimage cards rather than real-time mirrors. Purple floor pixels and warm sconces keep the path readable while false reflections imply extra passages.
nodes.accessibility_note: Motion reduction replaces moving lag with one static offset afterimage and steady floor lights.

nodes.visual_description: The grand hall compresses into an L-shaped wing of denser cabinets, lower warm lamps and stronger green haze. Two visually different recesses prevent the hidden destinations from being confused: the Taproom cue is velvet, vapor and brass; the restroom cue is broken dance hardware, warning labels and a steel service door.
nodes.boundary_rule: This node shows approaches only. Neither destination interior is visible beyond its transition threshold.

nodes.visual_description: A cracked Time Crisis cabinet is pulled slightly off the wall, revealing a glowing green velvet curtain. Vapor seeps underneath in impossible curls. A small brass plaque reads NOT RECOMMENDED FOR THOSE PRONE TO INTROSPECTION. After 20:00 the glow slowly breathes.
A non-rendered boundary directly behind the curtain. Fade or scene transition before any Taproom interior is shown.

A broken dance machine blocks part of a steel service recess without obstructing the main route. Three dark circular token pips sit beside a hacked coin slot. Each inserted token lights one pip green. The adjacent door bears a smudged MAINTENANCE ONLY label under an XXX PAC-MAN promo sticker.

A narrow dented steel door with layered stickers, a broken latch wired to the DDR coin board, and a small indicator that changes from red to green after three tokens. No restroom interior is visible from the Arcade.

nodes.display_name: Transition to Claw Machine Maintenance Closet Restroom
nodes.visual_description: A non-rendered boundary behind the service door. Transition before revealing any restroom fixtures, graffiti or interior layout.

feature_details.central_landmark_rule: The bottle bar must remain the strongest interior mass and should be visible from the vestibule, token exchange, cabinet loop and start of the north wing.

hidden_entrance_separation.taproom: soft velvet, green vapor, brass plaque, cracked gun cabinet, slow breathing light
hidden_entrance_separation.restroom: hard steel, broken dance machine, warning labels, exposed wiring, three token pips

feature_details.sublocation_boundary_rule: Generate only the Arcade-facing approaches. Never show the Taproom Distortion Den or the restroom's fixtures and graffiti in an Absinthe Arcade interior image.
feature_details.circulation_clearance: Keep a continuous player-width loop around the bottle bar and a clear path to both northern recesses; furniture and comedy props stay out of the primary route.
feature_details.vertical_read: Use the mezzanine as visual depth and ambient NPC space, not as a required gameplay floor unless a later implementation explicitly adds navigation.

ambient_npcs.density_rule: Do not crowd Backpack Girl's silhouette, the claw controls, the DDR token pips, or either hidden entrance handle.
